decision.rationale: R1 located a geometry-key error: the p6 local-action cache rounded actual cell widths to 12 decimal places, allowing distinct exact widths to share an operator. The Task40 exact-geometry path now preserves the actual mesh geometry. On the saved iteration-8 vector, an independent raw-FFCx replay under that path passes the original strict identity limit. No unexplained residual remains that would justify enabling the separately defined budget B.

frozen_physical_identity.identity_check: The added review inputs resolve to the same frozen physical-model hashes as their respective original G0/G1 inputs; only run identity and review accounting are new. Both run_case --validate-only invocations passed.

r1_localization.scope: One G0 p6 operator diagnostic; no full p4 factor. The diagnostic located the rounded-width cache identity mismatch.

attempt4_historical_stop.preservation: Historical failure remains unchanged; it is not relabeled as a pass.

exact_geometry_replay.coverage_gap: The three geometry-dominant spot-check cells have zero local RHS and zero Bi*alpha terms. The recheck correctly records this as a coverage gap, not a numerical failure. The full R1 inventory has 984 nonzero Bi and 984 nonzero Di entries; the existing nonzero-RHS and non-Hermitian fixtures listed below were run under the current qualified ABI.
exact_geometry_replay.iteration8_limit: Saved mid-iteration vector only. The replay did not run KSP, a full G0 solve, a p4 factorization, or a direct reference; its A6 residual is not a convergence result.

current_abi_fixtures.scope: Real FFCx/MPC action fixture with nonzero RHS; no global engineering factor.
